_fonte: Token KAT grid, pre-registered in data/prereg/02-token-kat-addendum.md. Single source: read by the analytic table (code/token_kat_analytic_table.py) and by the literal token-budget simulation (code/token_kat.py, code/run_token_kat.py). Never edit it after its sha256 was recorded: the sha256 of this file is written into output/kat_token/resumo.json (grade_sha256) and into the first line of data/prereg/kat_token_analytic_table.txt.
_custos: k in tokens per event: 14 = compact transaction of nuFormer (Appendix A, 'each transaction consumes 14 tokens on average'); 55 = plain-text transaction (Section 1, 'approximately 55 tokens per transaction'). Inputs E1 of configs/estimates_inputs.json. K = 2048 = nuFormer context length (Section 4.2).

celulas.discrimina: per-event rule (ignores k) predicts IMPROVES; per-token rule predicts WORSENS
same as S1a with λ_S tripled (Corollary 2: sign constant in λ_S)
per-event rule predicts WORSENS; per-token rule predicts IMPROVES
same as S2a with λ_S tripled (Corollary 2: sign constant in λ_S)
ρ̄ weighted by OCCUPANCY (λk) predicts IMPROVES; ρ̄ weighted by RATE (λ) predicts WORSENS
θ·ρ̄ < ρ_S < ρ̄: IMPROVES; Corollary 1 applied outside the saturation of R predicts WORSENS
same (R, S) as MIX1, only λ_S changes: ρ_S < θ·ρ̄, WORSENS; 'a source with d_S > 0 never hurts' predicts IMPROVES
ρ_S < ρ̄ with R ∪ S unsaturated: IMPROVES (Corollary 3); Corollary 1 applied without saturation predicts WORSENS

_regras_ingenuas: evento = Corollary 1 with k ignored (d_S² against the rate-weighted mean of d²); taxa = ρ̄ weighted by λ instead of λk; cor1_fora_da_saturacao = ρ_S against ρ̄ without checking whether R saturates; monotonia = 'a source with d_S > 0 never hurts'. Each cell declares the naive rule it refutes: the analytic table asserts that this rule predicts the sign OPPOSITE to the closed form.
